meta.title: KPI背后的复仇女神｜必须设对冲指标
meta.title_en: The Revenge Goddess Behind Every KPI

scenes.title_en: Understanding a guru's words after years
scenes.context: 讲者回忆小白时期听马云讲「厉害的领导很会设KPI」觉得简单，做了培训经理才发现很难。
sentences: 一开始是小白，听大咖说一句话觉得平淡无奇。
At first I was a novice and a guru's words sounded nothing special.
平淡无奇：nothing special
直到自己真正做了这些事情，才发现真的很有道理。
It wasn't until I actually did these things that I realized how true it was.
直到真正做了：not until I actually did it
真正厉害的领导者，是很会设 KPI 的。
Truly great leaders are masters of setting KPIs.
很会设KPI：masters of setting KPIs
paraphrase: 听大咖的话 → 觉得简单
Hearing a guru's words feels simple at first.
亲身实践 → 才真正理解
Only hands-on practice reveals the real depth.
scenes.speak: At first I was a novice and a guru's words sounded nothing special. It wasn't until I actually did these things that I realized how true it was. Truly great leaders are masters of setting KPIs.

scenes.title_cn: 复仇女神：考核什么就扭曲什么
scenes.title_en: The revenge goddess: measure it, and it gets gamed
scenes.context: 讲者做思想实验：只设销售额一个KPI，公司一定完蛋，因为销售会亏本卖。
sentences: 如果只设一个 KPI，那一定是销售额，对吗？
If you set only one KPI, it would be sales, right?
只设一个：set only one
只考核销售额，这家公司一定完蛋。
If sales is the only metric, the company is doomed.
一定完蛋：is doomed
每一个 KPI 背后，都有一个复仇女神。
Every KPI has a revenge goddess behind it.
复仇女神：revenge goddess
paraphrase: 考核销售额 → 就有人钻空子
Measure sales, and people will game it.
复仇女神 → 单指标的代价
Every single metric has a hidden cost.
scenes.speak: If you set only one KPI, it would be sales, right? If sales is the only metric, the company is doomed. Every KPI has a revenge goddess behind it.

scenes.title_en: The fix: a system of hedging KPIs
scenes.context: 讲者给出解法——KPI要互相牵制对冲，并警示单指标的漏洞现实。
sentences: 除了销售额，还要考核利润率，把亏本卖的风险对冲掉。
Besides sales, also measure profit margin to hedge against selling at a loss.
对冲风险：hedge the risk
一个好的 KPI，是互相牵制对冲的几个指标组成的系统。
A good KPI is a system of metrics that check and balance each other.
互相牵制：check and balance
聪明人专门抓这个漏洞，跳去下一家高薪公司。
Smart people game this loophole and jump to better-paid companies.
抓漏洞：game the loophole
paraphrase: 利润率对冲销售额 → 牵制
Pairing profit with sales keeps them in balance.
单指标漏洞 → 被人钻空子
A single metric leaves room to be gamed.
scenes.speak: Besides sales, also measure profit margin to hedge against selling at a loss. A good KPI is a system of metrics that check and balance each other. Smart people game this loophole and jump to better-paid companies.

practice: Leaders are masters of setting KPIs.
The company is doomed with a single metric.
We hedge the risk by also measuring profit.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：Every KPI has a revenge goddess.
✓ 地道说法：Every KPI comes with unintended consequences.
revenge goddess 是讲者比喻，直译保留；通用表达用 unintended consequences。
✓ 地道说法：Track sales alone / measure only sales.
track 比 measure 在口语中更自然。
✓ 地道说法：The company is doomed.
用 doomed 表达「必然完蛋」更地道。
✕ 直译腔：Make the KPI check each other.
✓ 地道说法：Metrics that check and balance each other.
check and balance 是固定搭配。
shifts: 把 KPI 当作「简单的数字考核」
把 KPI 当作「行为设计」
只问「这个指标达标了吗」
先问「这个指标会被怎样钻空子」
把设 KPI 当作管理者核心能力
footer_notes: ASR 专有名词已按语境校正（如「负重女神」按上下文校正为「复仇女神」）。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
